result.changelog:
Fixed all 6 errors: Torizo moved to Samus's return; the Maridia entrance contradiction resolved in favour of the Brinstar tunnel; the Tourian seal corrected to the Golden Statue of Kraid/Phantoon/Draygon/Ridley; Mother Brain now delivers the SR388 reports rather than receiving them; Kraid's rebuilt lair placed inside Brinstar, east of the Norfair elevator; the Legendary Power Suit loss moved to after the SR388 infection, before the BSL incident.
Unverified items: 'The timing of my escape couldn't have been worse' was confirmed on the Metroid Wiki Samus Aran page and kept. Removed: the 'nightmare version of Zebes' Bottle Ship line (not found by fetch or search), 'emergency order' (now 'as a last resort'), and 'kept the suit through every later mission'.
Added: Samus's age of three (per the manga); the Fall of Zebes Pirate log and the escape of the Orpheon, Siriacus and Vol Paragom, with the Orpheon's distress signal later bringing Samus to Tallon IV; the Unknown Item locations; Mother Brain's destroyed tank in old Tourian; Gray Voice's DNA link to Samus and his skyward last attack; Cataris on ZDR.
Labelled manga-only material, including the Chozo creating Mother Brain and the Chozo abandoning Chozodia. Dropped meta wording ('Mini-Boss' manual quote, the Rinka manual parenthetical).
Keys: Zebetite keys now only on Tourian. Dropped generic keys: time bomb, Pirate headquarters, giant lizard, saurian, first mission, original mission, Zebes mission, space hunter, the bare Mother Ship/Mothership forms, Wrecked Ship. Moved 'fall of Zebes' to the first-mission entry. Added Golden Statue, Mecha Ridley, Paralyzer, 'Zebes was destroyed' and similar phrasings, and plurals.
Trimmed the Regions, Chozodia and Zero Mission entries. The Chozodia title now says Ruins Test instead of Chozo Ruins.
result.unresolved: The Kraid-X-Raven Beak link comes only from Wikipedia's Dread plot summary; no Metroid Wiki page confirms it. Metroid Wiki contradicts itself on where the original Tourian was (under Crateria or reached from Brinstar); the entries say it was reached by a shaft from Brinstar and that its ruins lie in lowest Crateria. The Etecoon/Dachora rescue is optional in the source but is stated as fact by choice. The Unknown Item locations (Crateria, Kraid's lair, Ridley's lair) come from the fact-check report and were not re-fetched. Three entries are long but under the 550-word cap for the biggest subjects (overview 444, Mother Brain 432, Zero Mission 452 words); Regions is 402.
